title: Coefficient of a shifted polynomial
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number and let $a\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^\ell$. For every natural number $d$, the coefficient of degree $d$ in $X A(X)$, where $A(X)=\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}a_iX^i$, is $0$ when $d=0$ and otherwise is the coefficient of $A(X)$ in degree $d-1$ (taken to be $0$ when $d-1\ge\ell$).
